title: Apartment lobby
scenario: Your neighbor Mr. Chen is walking to the glass doors with his hands full carrying a big box.

helpful.label: Open the door
helpful.feedback: Opening the door for someone whose hands are full is a wonderful, friendly act. That's what real helpers do!

ignore.label: Keep using phone
ignore.feedback: Your phone can wait. Mr. Chen needs a hand right now. Look up, someone may need you!

careless.label: Bump into the box
careless.feedback: Rushing past without looking bumped the box and nearly made Mr. Chen drop everything. Slow down and look around!

in_the_way.label: Block the door
in_the_way.feedback: Standing in the doorway makes it even harder for Mr. Chen to get through. A good helper clears the way!

badge_line: You opened the door for Mr. Chen when his hands were full.

title: School corridor
scenario: Your classmate Tsz Yan, the girl with the ponytail, left her red locker open. Her books are about to slide out.

helpful.label: Close her locker
helpful.feedback: You tucked the books back and closed the locker for Tsz Yan. Now her things are safe. That's a real helper!

ignore.label: Keep walking to class
ignore.feedback: Tsz Yan's books could fall and get stepped on. A helper notices when a friend forgets something.

careless.label: Run into the locker
careless.feedback: Running without looking banged the locker door, and the books tumbled onto the floor. Walk slowly in the corridor!

in_the_way.label: Borrow without asking
in_the_way.feedback: Taking Tsz Yan's book without asking isn't fair, even for a minute. Help keep a friend's things safe instead.

badge_line: You closed Tsz Yan's locker so her books stayed safe.

title: Classroom
scenario: Your classmate Priya, at the desk on the right, opens her pink pencil case and finds no pencil to write with.

helpful.label: Share your pencil
helpful.feedback: Sharing your pencil means Priya can join in the lesson too. Small kind acts make the whole class happier!

ignore.label: Keep drawing doodles
ignore.feedback: Doodling is fun, but Priya can't start her work. A helper notices when a classmate is stuck.

careless.label: Knock over her case
careless.feedback: Rushing to your seat knocked Priya's pencil case off the desk, and everything spilled. Walk slowly between desks!

in_the_way.label: Take the spare pencils
in_the_way.feedback: Taking all the spare pencils leaves none for Priya. Sharing means everyone gets a turn to learn.

badge_line: You shared your pencil so Priya could write.

title: Estate playground
scenario: Grandma Wong, in the apron under the climbing frame, is sweeping up leaves, but her blue dustpan is by the slide.

helpful.label: Bring the dustpan
helpful.feedback: Bringing the dustpan to Grandma Wong saves her a long walk. Helping grown-ups with their work is so kind!

ignore.label: Keep sliding down
ignore.feedback: Sliding is fun, but Grandma Wong is bending and stretching for her dustpan. A helper notices and lends a hand.

careless.label: Run through the leaves
careless.feedback: Running through the pile scattered the leaves all over again. Now Grandma Wong has to start over. Look before you run!

in_the_way.label: Stand on the dustpan
in_the_way.feedback: Standing on the dustpan means Grandma Wong can't use it. A good helper clears the way so the work gets done.

badge_line: You brought Grandma Wong her dustpan so she could finish sweeping.

title: Library
scenario: Your little cousin Lucas, at the blue table, wants more picture books from the box but cannot carry them all.

helpful.label: Carry some books
helpful.feedback: Carrying some books to the table means Lucas can keep reading. Helping little ones makes them feel cared for!

ignore.label: Run off to play
ignore.feedback: Playing is fun, but Lucas can't carry all his books. A helper notices when little ones are stuck.

careless.label: Trip over the box
careless.feedback: Hurrying without looking tipped the book box over, and books spilled everywhere. Walk slowly in the library!

in_the_way.label: Take the books first
in_the_way.feedback: Grabbing the books Lucas wanted leaves him with none. Let little ones have a turn and help them instead.

badge_line: You carried picture books to the table for your cousin Lucas.

title: Cha chaan teng
scenario: Auntie May, laughing in the red booth on the right, dropped her chopsticks on the floor and cannot reach them.

helpful.label: Get a clean pair
helpful.feedback: Picking up the dropped chopsticks and bringing Auntie May a clean pair means she can keep eating. So thoughtful!

ignore.label: Play with your straw
ignore.feedback: Playing is fun, but Auntie May is stuck without chopsticks. A helper notices when someone at the table needs a hand.

careless.label: Knock over the tea
careless.feedback: Hopping off your seat without looking knocked over the milk tea, and now the table is wet too. Move carefully at the table!

in_the_way.label: Crowd her booth seat
in_the_way.feedback: Squeezing into Auntie May's seat means she can't move to reach anything. Give people space and help them instead.

badge_line: You got Auntie May a clean pair of chopsticks.

title: MTR
scenario: Your cousin Chloe, in the white school blouse on the left, is busy on her phone. Her big black bag is slipping off her lap.

helpful.label: Catch her bag
helpful.feedback: Catching Chloe's bag before it fell kept her things safe. Telling her kindly helps too. Nice helping!

ignore.label: Keep playing your game
ignore.feedback: Your game can wait. Chloe's bag is about to fall. A helper keeps an eye out for family.

careless.label: Bump into her bag
careless.feedback: Wobbling down the train without holding on bumped Chloe's bag right onto the floor. Hold the pole and move carefully!

in_the_way.label: Crowd Chloe's seat
in_the_way.feedback: Squeezing onto Chloe's seat pushes her bag even closer to the edge. Give people room on the train.

badge_line: You caught Chloe's bag before it fell on the train.

title: Supermarket
scenario: Grandpa Lee, in the white vest, is pushing a trolley so full that snack bags keep falling off the top.

helpful.label: Pick up the snacks
helpful.feedback: Picking up the fallen snacks and putting them back helps Grandpa Lee keep going. Helping family shop is so kind!

ignore.label: Go look at drinks
ignore.feedback: The drinks can wait. Grandpa Lee's snacks keep falling. A helper notices when family needs help.

careless.label: Stomp on the snacks
careless.feedback: Running without looking stomped on the fallen snacks, and now they're squashed. Watch where you walk!

in_the_way.label: Block the trolley
in_the_way.feedback: Standing in front of the trolley means Grandpa Lee can't move, and more snacks fall. A good helper clears the way.

badge_line: You helped Grandpa Lee pick up his fallen snacks.

title: Park
scenario: Grandpa Lee, on the green bench, is enjoying the sun, but the wind is blowing his spare newspaper off the bench.

helpful.label: Catch the newspaper
helpful.feedback: Catching the pages and handing them back means Grandpa Lee can keep reading. Little helps make a big difference!

ignore.label: Run off to play
ignore.feedback: Playing is fun, but Grandpa Lee's newspaper is blowing away. A helper stops for a moment to lend a hand.

careless.label: Run through the pages
careless.feedback: Running through the pages tore them and blew them even farther. Slow down and look before you run!

in_the_way.label: Sit on the newspaper
in_the_way.feedback: Sitting on the newspaper crumples it so Grandpa Lee can't read it. A good helper hands things back neatly.

badge_line: You caught Grandpa Lee's newspaper before it blew away.

title: Basketball court
scenario: Your teammate Omar, in his blue PE kit at the back, dropped his ball and it rolled under the ball rack. He looks embarrassed.

helpful.label: Help get the ball
helpful.feedback: Helping Omar get his ball back lets him join in again. Good teammates help each other, especially after a mistake!

ignore.label: Keep bouncing
ignore.feedback: Bouncing is fun, but Omar is stuck and feels embarrassed. A good teammate notices and helps.

careless.label: Knock over the rack
careless.feedback: Racing over without looking knocked the ball rack, and balls rolled everywhere. Slow down on the court!

in_the_way.label: Take his ball first
in_the_way.feedback: Grabbing Omar's ball first leaves him with nothing to play with. Good teammates give the ball back.

badge_line: You helped your teammate Omar get his ball back.
